description: This file defines the IniFileReader class, which provides static methods for parsing and reading .ini style configuration files. It includes methods to split lines into tokens considering quotes and separators, as well as methods to read from InputStreams or Files, returning a RawIniFile object representing the parsed data.

classes.name: IniFileReader
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to read and parse ini configuration files.

methods.name: splitTokens
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on separators (space, tab, '=', ',') while respecting quoted substrings.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and parses ini file data from an InputStream or File, returning a RawIniFile object containing the parsed lines.
